verdict.rationale: Netlify docs show explicit AI-agent integration—prompting agents to fix/update/ship code from the dashboard and connecting AI assistants to the account—plus an llms.txt for LLM consumption and an AI Gateway, indicating some natural-language/agentic operation support. However, there's no evidence of comprehensive natural-language control over all platform functions (deploys, DNS, billing, etc.), so this is partial rather than full.
